title: fix(runtime)!: an analytics query that selects nothing answers 400 VALIDATION_FAILED at the entry
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao6bxiPKCvVuzoFTExumbxoz)_
Fixes #33840
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — nothing under skills/ covers analytics/query projection or an empty measures

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:调用分析查询接口却既没选指标也没选维度的调用方,现在立刻收到“请至少选择一个指标或维度”的 400 提示,而不是服务器内部错误 500;预览生成语句的接口同样拒绝,不再回显一条坏语句。
- 为什么做:来自质检回归发现的仪表板查询负例,修补分析查询入口校验的缺口,让调用方的输入错误不再被报成服务器故障。
- 出错会怎样:属破坏性收窄(BREAKING):此前预览生成语句的接口对这种空查询回 200,现在回 400;最坏情况是把本来合法的查询误拒为 400,调用方会立刻看到;改动只在入口多一条校验,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:这是申报的收窄,按 #35610 需要你在 GitHub 上点一次 Approve;之后席位自主落地。
- 席位意见:通过,没有必改项(席位记录见本 PR 评论)。

## What changes

`POST /api/v1/analytics/query` with `measures: []` and no dimensions passed the entry check (the schema accepts an empty `measures` because a dimension-only query is legal, and it has no cross-field rule), reached the native SQL strategy, which assembled `SELECT  FROM "TABLE"`, and answered `500 DATABASE_ERROR`. The `/analytics/sql` door echoed the same statement as a 200.

`assertAnalyticsQueryBody` (runtime, `packages/runtime/src/domains/analytics.ts`) now runs one more rule after the schema parse succeeds: a query that selects no measure, no dimension and no `timeDimensions` entry carrying a `granularity` is refused with the existing `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` and one `details.fields[]` entry `{ field: 'measures', code: 'min_items' }` whose message tells the caller to select at least one measure or dimension. Both `/analytics/query` and `/analytics/sql` call this one function, so the `/sql` echo is covered by the same guard with no extra code. The body is still forwarded untouched when it passes.

What counts as a projection follows what the strategies group or aggregate by: a measure, a dimension, or a bucketed time dimension (the ObjectQL strategy turns each granularity into a group key). A time dimension with only a `dateRange` is a filter and selects nothing on its own, so it does not rescue an empty projection.

No spec change, no new error code (`VALIDATION_FAILED` and the `min_items` field code are existing catalog members). Changeset: `@objectstack/runtime` patch.

**BREAKING (narrowing).** `AnalyticsQuerySchema` admits `measures: []` with no minimum, so the refused body was inside the published accept set, and `/analytics/sql` answered it with a 200 before this change. Where the engine refused such a body before choosing a strategy, that refusal now becomes the same 400 at `measures`, measured on the engine at this head for both strategies and both doors: an unknown or `public: false` cube (`404 CUBE_NOT_FOUND`), a cube over an object the caller may not read (`403 PERMISSION_DENIED`), and an `order` key naming no selected member (`400 INVALID_FIELD`). On a deployment the ObjectQL strategy serves, `/analytics/query` answered a 200 with one row that carries no column. Declared `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, as the dataset-door twin was; the changeset carries the FROM/TO, the caller's one-line fix and the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`: no schema key, export, stored row or authored value moves.

**Read first (by risk):**
1. `packages/runtime/src/domains/analytics.ts`, the new `assertAnalyticsQuerySelectsSomething` and its call at the end of `assertAnalyticsQueryBody` (the risk hunk: the bucketed time-dimension exemption, which keeps a granularity-only query reaching the engine).
2. `packages/runtime/src/analytics-empty-projection-refusal.test.ts` (refusal and preservation pins on both doors).

**Two-minute check:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/analytics-empty-projection-refusal.test.ts` shows 20 passed.

## Tests

New `packages/runtime/src/analytics-empty-projection-refusal.test.ts`, driving the mounted routes through `dispatcher-plugin` with the harness of the sibling empty-cube test, on both `/analytics/query` and `/analytics/sql`:
- refusal: `{measures: []}`, `{measures: [], dimensions: []}`, and `{measures: []}` with a date-range-only time dimension each answer 400, `error.code` `VALIDATION_FAILED`, `error.httpStatus` 400, one field entry at `measures` with code `min_items`, and the service is never called;
- the envelope parses against `ApiErrorSchema`;
- preservation: one measure and no dimension, a dimension-only query, and a bucketed time dimension alone each reach the service with the body untouched;
- precedence: an unknown cube with an empty projection gets the 400 at `measures` and never reaches a stub engine that answers `CUBE_NOT_FOUND` / 404 for that cube; control: the same cube with one measure reaches it and answers the 404; and `where`, `order` and `limit` with an empty projection are still refused.

<details><summary>Readings (head d8fc05159a unless noted)</summary>

- new file + sibling empty-cube test at d8fc05159a: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 24 passed (24)`, lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` at 5aeaf5975c (before the last commit, which only adds a module-top side-effect import to the new test): `Test Files 633 passed (633)`, `Tests 11669 passed | 25 skipped (11694)`, lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` at 5aeaf5975c: exit 0 (tsc and check:test-typecheck OK).
- Ablation (fix committed first; `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` deleted the call line, anchor 1 to 0, blob 2fa8f9336 to 614cfcb88): `Tests 8 failed | 6 passed (14)`, the 8 being the refusal and envelope cases on both doors, the 6 the preservation cases; restore verified blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. This red run is also the door-level reproduction: without the rule the empty projection reaches the service.
- Round 2 at d22928425c: the pin file has 20 tests, `Test Files 1 passed (1)` / `Tests 20 passed (20)`, VERDICT command-exit 0; runtime typecheck exit 0. Ablation again (call line deleted, blob 2fa8f9336 to 614cfcb88): `Tests 12 failed | 8 passed (20)`, the 12 being every refusal, envelope and precedence case on both doors, the 8 being the preservation cases and the 404 controls; restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Engine readings behind the BREAKING sentence, from a scratch test against `AnalyticsService` (deleted, not committed), body `measures: []`, on `query` and `generateSql` under each of the native SQL and ObjectQL strategies: unknown cube and `public: false` cube gave `CUBE_NOT_FOUND` 404; a walled object gave `PERMISSION_DENIED` 403; `order` on an unselected key gave `INVALID_FIELD` 400; the plain empty projection gave `SELECT  FROM` on `generateSql`, and on `query` a 200 with one columnless row under the ObjectQL strategy.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The live 500 was not re-measured on a booted showcase in this run; the card thread carries six live reproductions at f6f5b50a (QA run, comment 6946115523), and the door-level reproduction above shows the unfixed entry forwards the body.
- `/analytics/sql`: covered by the same guard with no extra code (both doors call `assertAnalyticsQueryBody`).
- The engine itself (`native-sql-strategy`) still builds an empty SELECT list for a caller that reaches it in-process without this door; not changed here (the card's route is the runtime door).

## Verification
